reason: I already run a chatbot I'm fine with, and switching means migration work for what is mostly a cute skin. If I wanted this I'd wire an LLM API to a little animated SVG over a weekend.
objection: Why pay 29-79 EUR a month for an animated mascot when my current chatbot already answers questions and I can build the on-site actions myself? Another vendor to maintain and migrate to.
would_change_my_mind: A mascot layer that sits on top of my existing Intercom/Crisp/Tidio bot with no migration, or a one-time or very cheap price for the character alone.
